basis: Item 8 draft, 2026-10-29. The strongest bright component in its 2048 px tile (tile_rank 0): about 1 percent of bright false alarms on the tuning strips, and five of the six recorded bright pieces. Not a physical test of the object itself but of its surroundings: hardware is the brightest thing within half a kilometre far more often than a rock is. Kept beside the adopted saturation rule.

rules.name: tile_top
rules.basis: the brightest compact object within its 512 m tile
